reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers

en: How many customers are in each province?
reference_sql: SELECT province, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers GROUP BY province ORDER BY province

en: What were monthly sales in 2024, counting completed orders only?
zh: 2024 年每月销售额（只算 completed 订单）？
reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month',o.order_date)::date AS month, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

en: What are the top five products by units sold on completed orders?
zh: 已完成订单中销量最高的 5 个产品？
reference_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(i.quantity) AS units FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id JOIN products p ON p.id=i.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.id,p.name ORDER BY units DESC,p.name LIMIT 5

en: Which category has the highest completed-order revenue?
zh: 已完成订单中哪个品类收入最高？
reference_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id JOIN products p ON p.id=i.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC,p.category LIMIT 1

en: What percentage of all orders were refunded?
zh: 退款订单占全部订单的百分比是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT 100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='refunded')/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS refund_percent FROM orders

en: What is the average completed order value?
zh: 已完成订单的平均客单价是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id),0) AS average_order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status='completed'

en: How much did Edmonton customers spend on completed orders?
zh: Edmonton 客户已完成订单的消费总额是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND c.city='Edmonton'
SELECT SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND c.city='Calgary'

en: By what percentage is Calgary spending higher or lower than Edmonton, using Edmonton as the baseline?
zh: 以 Edmonton 为基准，Calgary 的消费额高或低百分之多少？
reference_sql: WITH e AS (SELECT SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND c.city='Edmonton'), c AS (SELECT SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND c.city='Calgary') SELECT 100.0*(c.revenue-e.revenue)/NULLIF(e.revenue,0) AS percent_change FROM e CROSS JOIN c
